cards.review_notes: Prices and enrollment eligibility are from the undated Club FAQs, used as 2026 fallback information; verify them against the 2026 enrollment form or parent handbook. The FAQs require ages 5–18 and say children must currently be attending Kindergarten to be eligible; the kindergarten minimum is recorded without converting it to an age. The homepage and FAQs publish 413 East Vann Rd., while older campaign pages list 740 West Church Street; the current homepage/FAQ address is used. The full status is the still-published 2026 notice, not a 2027 availability statement.
